description: Inspect a chronological time range from a recording as one contact sheet. Preserves before/changed/after neighborhoods. Use to investigate a transition without calling get_frame separately for every frame. Times are acquisition milliseconds, not frame numbers. Original frames remain available with get_frame.

crop.description: Optional sub-rectangle to return at full resolution. Omit to get the whole frame.

h.description: Crop height (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default: to the bottom edge.

normalized.description: When true, x/y/w/h are fractions of the frame (0..1). When false/omitted, they are pixels.

w.description: Crop width (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default: to the right edge.

x.description: Left edge of the crop (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default 0.

y.description: Top edge of the crop (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default 0.

dir.description: Recording directory from a record/replay result.

endMs.description: Inclusive end time in milliseconds (default last frame).

maxFrames.description: Maximum displayed frames (default 12). If fewer fit, selection retains transition context.

name: get_frames
